title: SM ST8C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST8C 静态励磁系统，带有自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} 指定电压调节器的比例增益、{Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} 指定电压调节器的积分增益、{Maximum voltage regulator output, V_PImax (pu)} 指定 PI 调节器的最大输出、{Minimum voltage regulator output, V_PImin (pu)} 指定 PI 调节器的最小输出、{Field current regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} 指定磁场电流调节器的比例增益、{Field current regulator integral gain, K_IA (pu/s)} 指定励磁电流调节器的积分增益、{Maximum exciter output, V_Amax (pu)} 指定励磁机输出上限、{Minimum exciter output, V_Amin (pu)} 指定励磁机输出下限、{Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent gain, K_A (pu)} 指定整流桥增益、{Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} 指定整流桥时间常数、{Maximum field current regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器的最大输出、{Minimum field current regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} 指定励磁电流调节器的最小输出、{Exciter field current feedback gain, K_F (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流反馈增益、{Field current feedback time constant, T_F (s)} 指定反馈时间常数、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路增益系数、{Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定与电势源相关的电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B1max (pu)} 指定最大可用励磁机磁场电压、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)} 指定与换相电抗成正比的整流器负载系数、{Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} 指定复励回路电流增益系数、{Maximum available exciter field voltage, V_B2max (pu)} 指定最大可用励磁机磁场电压、{Power source selector} 指定电源选择器 Position A: power source derived from generator terminal，按实例取值。
